title: Lower global LAMBDA gates to charged ordinary passes (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope
Lower #6902's global LAMBDA normalizers to initialized scratch, COPY-as-addition, fixed translation, Gaussian-dyadic combination and clear, at every positive width. The coefficients remain outside tensor powers. All 12,896 uses are separately charged; no recursive Gaussian child or target credit is introduced.

The conservative raw total including an extra 12,896,000 route debit is 983,967,328, below 10^9. Scratch peak remains 30; E_out≤2E+D+R retains dirty residuals. No new κ.

## Sources and verification
Base: 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a.
Head: 5cca8d4442d434a873ef905ffdea4b80bf9f2e34.
Source #6902: e4d42607f24d7a049b0fca329dc4c34882405c25; exact pins in SOURCES.json/RETAINED.json.

Run:
`python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/global-lambda-lowering`

Fresh Python 3.12.14 replay passed all four registered normal/optimized checks, source/mutation controls, dense width-two execution and code-disjoint Fourier oracle. Expected: PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE. Committed bytes/modes and whitespace pass. Later #6902 changes leave executable inputs unchanged.

## Limits and credit
The allowance is finite route accounting, not tape steps. Physical movement, owned erasure, compiler, BIT and all five assumptions remain. No supplier admission or frontier change.

@CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Checkers differ in mechanism/code, not original authorship. Credit DreamingOfClouds, zxv, #6763/#6735, Matarener (#5445) and retained authors. Apache-2.0.
